title: Aaron and His Sons
backstory: The tabernacle was up and the offerings commanded — Moses had finished the work (Exodus 40:33). But someone still had to carry those offerings in to God on behalf of everyone else, and God had already named who: Aaron his brother, and Aaron's sons with him (Exodus 28:1). What happens next shows both the glory of coming near to God and how serious it is.

passages.synopsis: Moses set apart Aaron and his sons to serve as priests. He washed them, clothed them in the holy garments, and anointed them with oil. This ordination showed that those who come near to God must be consecrated. Aaron was made high priest for the people.

After the first offerings, Aaron blessed the people, and the glory of the LORD appeared. Fire came out from before the LORD and consumed the offering on the altar. When the people saw it, they shouted for joy and fell on their faces. God had accepted their worship.

Aaron's sons Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire the LORD had not commanded. Fire went out from the LORD and they died before him. God is holy and must be honored by those who draw near. It was a solemn warning to take his presence seriously.

triviaQuestions.question: What appeared and consumed the offering when Aaron finished?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Leviticus 9:24 — "And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces."

triviaQuestions.question: Why did Nadab and Abihu die before the LORD?
options: They offered strange fire He had not commanded
triviaQuestions.explanation: Leviticus 10:2 — "And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD."

triviaQuestions.question: What did Moses put in the breastplate when he clothed Aaron?
triviaQuestions.explanation: Leviticus 8:8 — "And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim."

triviaQuestions.question: What did Aaron do when he came down from offering for the people?
options: He went home to his tent
He set up a pillar of stone
He lifted up his hand and blessed them
triviaQuestions.explanation: Leviticus 9:22 — "And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings."

reflection: God is holy, and coming near to Him is a serious gift. What does it mean to treat God with reverence?
